## Checklist

- [ ] **No personal data** (names, places, accounts, phone numbers, emails, sensitive details) / **Sem dados pessoais**
- [ ] Anything that sends, books, buys or deletes asks the user first / Tudo o que envia, reserva, compra ou apaga pergunta antes
- [ ] Follows [FORMAT.md](https://github.com/olserra/assistant-packs/blob/main/FORMAT.md) and the [quality bar](https://github.com/olserra/assistant-packs/blob/main/docs/pack-authoring.md#quality-bar) / Segue o formato e os critérios de qualidade
- [ ] I added myself to [CONTRIBUTORS.md](https://github.com/olserra/assistant-packs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTORS.md) (and `credits` in `pack.yaml` for pack changes) / Acrescentei-me aos contribuidores
- [ ] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/olserra/assistant-packs/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) / Aceito o Código de Conduta
